description: This Java class handles the posting of interest to a savings account in the Fineract platform. It implements the command handler interface, uses dependency injection for the service layer, and defines a method to process the command for posting interest.

classes.name: PostInterestSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles commands to post interest to a savings account using the specified service. It is marked as a Spring service and as a command handler for the entity 'SAVINGSACCOUNT' and action 'POSTINTEREST'.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to post interest to the savings account by invoking the corresponding method on the write platform service. It is transactional.
